scope: M0 corrective remediation only. No M1 work, no APEX features, no threshold/acceptance-gate changes.

changes.detail: Wrapped two previously unguarded decoders inside evaluate_gates() in try/catch: (1) G1 StaticHardwareProfile::from_json(hw_rec.hardware); (2) G5 ParameterAccounting::from_json(r.accounting). On std::exception the gate is set to FAIL with a 'malformed ...' detail string.
changes.why: Both paths threw std::runtime_error out of evaluate_gates, aborting the aggregator with exit 127 on evidence that ExperimentRecord::validate() accepted. This violated M0 section 2 ('malformed input must be rejected cleanly - no crash') and section 3 ('missing or invalid evidence fails closed').
evidence: fixtures/probe-malformed-profile: before exit=127 what(): json: missing key 'cpu_model' -> after exit=1 [FAIL] G1
fixtures/probe-malformed-accounting: before exit=127 what(): json: expected uint -> after exit=1 [FAIL] G5

changes.nature: corrected v1.7 syntax + added v1.8 regression tests
detail: Section 1: restored the samplesB declaration in the v1.7 different-distributions block from a // comment to live code; test data unchanged; added explicit medianA == 1.0 / medianB == 1.0 assertions.

Section 2: added deserialization-boundary tests through Statistics::from_json, ExperimentRecord::parse, RecordStore::loadAll and the aggregator record-loading/strict-mode contract (coverage matrix in report section 2).
Section 3: added profiler-kind exclusion tests and the exact 0.001% median-tolerance boundary (just inside PASS / just outside FAIL).
Section 3.1: added regression tests asserting no throw escapes evaluate_gates and that G1/G5 fail closed with a reason.
Replaced two tautological assertions found in self-review (CHECK(!x || true), CHECK(true) in a catch) with real either-or invariants.

changes.detail: Generates two disclosed controlled fixtures required by section 6: controlled-invalid-raw-sample (samples[3] is a string) and controlled-incorrect-stored-median (stored median 3x its own recomputed median). Derived from the real controlled-valid records with one disclosed edit each; every directory carries a README.txt.
Generates the probe fixture that reproduces the G1 fail-open crash: PROFILE record whose hardware block is non-null but missing cpu_model.

Reproducible driver running the real aggregate.exe over all 12 inputs x 2 configs x 2 modes (48 runs), recording exact exit codes, pass/fail counts, record counts and invalid-record counts into reports/v18-aggregator/.
